description:
What an AI vendor can buy on Hokai, with live prices and limits: a listing
    (Get listed), a labelled Sponsored spot in a guide (Guide spots) and buyer
    leads (Leads). Includes every guide open for booking with its slug, its
    next free date and its expected reach for the next three months (a
    projection, not a promise). Call this before buy_listing, buy_guide_spot
    or buy_leads.
name: vendor_catalog
